title: Chang'an–Luoyang imperial corridor
shortSummary: The route organizes political, educational, religious and human movement between the two capitals as a spatial research frame.
curatorialDescription: It is not a claim of one precisely reconstructed road, but a model built from cities, passes, valleys and institutional links.
researchNote: Period-specific branches, postal stations, distances and GIS sources remain to be added.
